summary: Lane workers stay native task subagents in the claimed worktree their assignment names, the coordinator's worktree or a concurrent group's member worktree (CD-0242 D5); a work item that touches a second repository gets a coordinator session in each repository, every verified landed session of the receiving Project may consume its shared handoff bind (CD-0182), and a worktree_claim for a Project in another repository refuses with cross_repository_claim before it creates a worktree; occupancy becomes one row per session carrying the host process identity, released by session_vacate, a verified landing elsewhere, or the end of the host process, and the caller-supplied session observation is no longer a release or removal input; removal content gates stay unchanged.
title: Lane workers stay native subagents, and each repository gets its own coordinator session
